detail.longDescription:
Shapes, Inc. is an AI group chat for getting things done with friends. Study together, research a question, plan a trip or work through code with AI and your people in the same room.

A trip you've talked about for months. A deadline nobody wants to mention. An idea that deserves more than “we should”. Bring it to Shapes.

Talk with your friends and AI in the same room. Our AI agents are called Shapes. Pick one you like, or invite a couple with different perspectives. Everyone can ask questions, add context and work on the answer together.

FROM “WE SHOULD” TO “WHO'S DOING WHAT?”
Open the shop. Make the zine. Start the side project. Ask a Shape to break it into steps, then figure out who does what with the people doing it with you.

ONE RABBIT HOLE. WHOLE GROUP INVITED.
Bring the article, the PDF or the question nobody can leave alone. Search the web, compare sources and ask follow-ups without copying answers between five different chats.

EXAM TOMORROW. NOBODY PANIC.
Get a hint when you're stuck on step two. Work through the maths. Ask for a quiz that waits for everyone to answer. Keep asking until it clicks.

THE TRIP MADE IT OUT OF THE CHAT.
Compare places, work out a budget and split the costs. Find a plan your friends can actually say yes to.

SAME BUG. MORE EYES.
Drop in the code, explain what broke and work through a fix with your teammates and a Shape. Ask the follow-up. Check the approach. Get back to building.

PICK YOUR EXTRA BRAINS.
Different Shapes, different personalities. Find one that fits your group. Invite another when you want a second take.

AND YES, YOU CAN STILL JUST HANG OUT.
Make an image. Go off topic. Come back to the project later. It's your chat.

Bring your people. Start something.
